43.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: “Come and I will show you the souls of the righteous that have been created and have returned, and the souls of the righteous that have not yet been created.” And he raised me up beside him, and I took hold of his hand, and he raised me up beside the Throne of Glory, beside the place of the Shekhinah. And he took me up to the Throne of Glory and showed me the Holy Creatures of heaven that had been created and had returned, which fly above the Throne of Glory and the face of the fla[me]. And afterward, I went and expounded upon this verse, and I found it to be according to the matter, as it is said: “For the spirit from before Me shall wrap, and the souls I have made” (Isa. 57:16). “The spirit from before Me shall wrap”—these are the souls that were created like a bird, the flight of the righteous, and they returned before the Throne; “and the souls I have made”—these are the souls of the righteous that have not yet been created as a bird.

44.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: “Come and I will show you where the souls of the wicked stand, and where the souls of the intermediate ones stand, and where the souls of the wicked [stand] … ”
44.2: “Where do they descend, and where do those of the wicked descend?” And he said to me: “The souls of the wicked descend to Sheol by means of six angels of destruction, and these are they: Za’afiel and Samkhiel. And Samkhiel is appointed over the souls of the intermediate ones in order to support them and purify them from sin, according to the abundance of the mercy of the Omnipresent. And Za’afiel is appointed over the souls of the wicked in order to cast them down from before the Holy One, blessed be He—from the judgment of the Shekhinah—to Sheol, to be judged in the fire of Gehenna, in a place of rivers.” And I went beside him, and he took hold of my hand and showed them all to me with the fingers of his hands. And I saw that the likeness of their faces was as the face of a human, but their bodies were like demons. Furthermore, the likeness of the souls of the intermediate ones resembled sparks, because of their deeds in which there is blemish, until they are purified of their iniquity in fire. And [likewise], the likeness of the souls of the wicked resembled the soot of a pot, because of the abundance of their deeds which are evil. And I saw the souls of the righteous—the perfect ones: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the rest of the righteous—whom they had raised up from their graves, and they ascend to the firmament and pray before the Holy One, blessed be He.
44.3: And they say in prayer before the Holy One, blessed be He: “Master of the Universe, how long will You sit upon Your throne while it sits [in mourning], and Your right hand is behind You, and You do not redeem Your children or exalt Your kingdom in the world? And do You not have compassion on Your children who are enslaved among the nations of the world? Concerning Your right hand, which is behind You—with which You once stretched out and spread the heavens and the highest heavens—do You not have compassion?” At that moment, the Holy One, blessed be He, returns an answer to each and every one of them—to Abraham individually, to Isaac individually, and to Jacob individually—and says: “Because these wicked ones have sinned before Me thus and so, and have acted wickedly before Me thus and so, and have sinned before Me thus and so, and have transgressed before Me—how can I bring salvation to My great right hand through the downfall of the uncircumcised?” At that moment, He called me and said to me: “Read, Metatron My servant; take the books and read their evil deeds.”
44.4: Immediately I drew forth the books and read their deeds; and there were found thirty-six [offenses punishable by] excision for each and every wicked person, as well as thirty-seven death penalties of the court for each and every wicked person, and so for each and every wicked person regarding Every wicked person [transgressed] against every letter of the Torah, as it is said: “The soul of the wicked has transgressed Your Torah.” Do not say it was not said so, but rather: “Your Torah”—for they transgressed from Aleph to Tav against the thirty-six [penalties of] excision in every single letter. Immediately, Abraham wept by himself, Isaac by himself, and Jacob by himself. And afterwards, the Holy One, blessed be He, said to them: “Abraham My beloved, Isaac My chosen, Jacob My firstborn—now, how can I deliver [them] from among the nations of the world?” And immediately Michael, who is of Israel, cried out and wept with a loud voice and said: “Why, O Lord, do You stand afar off?” etc.

45.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: “Come, and I will show you the ledger of the Omnipresent, which is spread before the Holy One, blessed be He, in which all the generations of the world and all the deeds of the generations of the world—whether those they have done or those they will do until the end of all generations—are engraved.” And I went, and he showed me with the finger of his hands, like a father who teaches his sons the letters of the Torah. And I saw every generation and its kings, every generation and its princes, every generation and its heads, every generation and its shepherds, every generation and its officers, every generation and its taskmasters, every generation and its scribes, every generation and its overseers, every generation and its judges, every generation and its scribes, every generation and its teachers, every generation and its workers, every generation and its oppressors, every generation and its pious ones, every generation and its servants, every generation and its parents, every generation and its sages, every generation and its heads, every generation and its heads, every generation and its heads, every generation and its heads of academies, every generation and its captains, every generation and its princes, every generation and its advocates, every generation and its chiefs, every generation and its ends, every generation and its nobles, every generation and its select ones, and their leaders.
45.2: And I saw Adam and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Noah and his generation and the generation of the Flood and their deeds and their thoughts; Shem and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Nimrod and his generation and the generation of the Division and their deeds and their thoughts; Abraham and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Isaac and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Ishmael and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Jacob and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; Joseph and his generation and their deeds and their thoughts; the tribes the tribes and their generation, and their deeds and their works; Amram and his generation, and his deeds and his works; Moses and his generation, and his deeds and his works; Aaron and his generation, and his deeds and his works; prophets and seers, and their deeds and their works; Joshua and his generation, and his deeds and his works; judges and their generation, and their deeds and their works; Eli and his generation, and his deeds and his works; Phinehas and his generation, their deeds and their works; Elkanah and his generation, their deeds and their works; Samuel and his generation, their deeds and their works; Saul and his generation, their deeds and their works; David and his generation, their deeds and their works; Solomon and his generation, their deeds and their works; the kings of Judah and their generation, their deeds and their works;
45.3: the kings of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the kings of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their thoughts; the princes of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the chiefs of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the chiefs of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the nobles of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their thoughts; the nobles of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the wealthy of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the wealthy of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the sages of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the sages of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the princes of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their thoughts; the princes of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the heads of academies and their generation, their deeds and their works; the heads of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the men of renown in Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works; the men of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the judges of Israel and their generation, their deeds and their works;
45.4: the judges of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; the teachers of children and their generation, their deeds and their works; the teachers of children among the nations of the world and their generation, and their deeds and their works; the advocates of Israel and their generation, and their deeds and their works; the advocates of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds and their works; and all the prophets of Israel and their generation, their deeds, and their works; and all the prophets of the nations of the world and their generation, their deeds, and their works; and all the battles of the wars that the nations of the world [fought] with Israel in the days of their kingdom; and I saw Messiah son of Joseph and his generation and their deeds that they do with the nations of the world; and I saw Messiah son of David and his generation, and all the battles and wars and their deeds and their works that they do with Israel, whether for good or for evil; and I saw all the battles and wars that such-and-such do with Israel in the days of the Messiah, and all that the Holy One, blessed be He, does with them in the time to come;
45.5: and all the rest of the leaders of the generation and all the deeds of the generation, whether in Israel or among the nations of the world, whether they have been done or whether they will be done in the time to come, for generations upon generations until the end, [all are] engraved upon the Curtain of the Omnipresent. And I saw them all in joy, and after I had seen, I opened my mouth and spoke the praise of the Omnipresent: "Where the word of a king is, there is power," etc.; "He who keeps the commandment shall know no evil thing"; and it says: "O Lord, how manifold are Your works!" etc.; and it says: "How great are Your works, O Lord!"

46.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: The spirit of the stars that are deep in the firmament every night in the pleasantness of the Omnipresent—where do they go and where do they stand? I went to him, and he took me by my hand and showed me all of them with his finger. And they stand like sparks of flame around the Chariot of the Omnipresent. What did Metatron do at that hour? He struck his palm against his palm and caused them all to fly from their place. Immediately they flew from their place like wings of flame and ascended and covered the four directions of the Throne of the Chariot. And he told me each and every one of their names and each and every one of their appellations, as it is said: "He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by name." This teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, [assigned] a name to every single star, and they all enter by count through the hand of Rahatiel the angel into the firmament of heaven to serve the world, and they depart by count to praise the Holy One, blessed be He, with songs and praises, as it is said: "The heavens declare the glory of God," etc. And in the time to come, the Holy One, blessed be He, will return and renew them as new, as it is said: "They are new every morning."
46.2: Every morning, etc., they open their mouths and utter song. And what song do they utter? “For His mercy is [unto] Your heavens,” etc.

47.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: “Come, and I will show you the joy of the angels and the spirit of the ministers, whose body He burns in the fire of the Omnipresent which issues from the little finger, and they become coals of flame within the River Dinur. Their spirit and their soul were standing behind the Shekhinah. Whenever the ministering angels utter song at an improper time, they are burned by His fire; and those [who sing] unsuitably are burned and scorched in the holy fire and in the flame of their Creator in their place. A stormy wind blows upon them and casts them into the River Dinur, and there they become mountains upon mountains of coals, and their spirit and their soul return to their Creator and all stand behind their Maker.” And I went with him, and he grasped me by my hand and showed me all of them—the joy of the angels and the spirit of the ministers as they stand behind the Shekhinah upon the measure of the storm, with walls of fire surrounding them. At that hour, Metatron opened for me the gates of the walls of fire within which they stand behind the Shekhinah. As soon as he caught my eye, I saw them; each and every one’s appearance was like the angels, and their wings were double wings of flame, exalted with burning fire. At that hour, I opened my mouth in praise of the Omnipresent and said: “Great are the works of the Lord.”

48.1: Rabbi Ishmael said: Metatron said to me: “Come, and I will show you the Right Hand of the Omnipresent, which is turned back because of the destruction of the Holy Temple; from it [shine] all kinds of brilliant lights, and by it nine hundred and fifty-five firmaments were created, which even Seraphim are not permitted to gaze upon until the arrival of the day of salvation.” And he came, and I went with him, and he grasped me by my hand and lifted me on his wings and showed it to me with all kinds of praise, song, and glory, of which no mouth can speak its praise, and no eye can gaze upon it because of the magnitude of its greatness, praise, value, honor, and glory. And not only that, but all the joy of the righteous who merit to see the joy of Jerusalem—they rejoice beside it and offer praise. crying out and seeking mercy from before Him, saying three times with weeping: “Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD,” even as it is said: “Who caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses.” At that hour, the Right Hand of the Omnipresent was weeping, and five rivers of tears spread out and issued forth from its five fingers and fell into the Great Sea and shook the whole world, even as it is said: “The earth is utterly broken, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly, the earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a night-lodge.”
48.2: And the explanation of “five times” corresponds to the five fingers of His great and awesome Right Hand. Behold, for there is no perfectly righteous man and no pious man on earth, and there is no merit in the hand of any man, and there is no man like Moses and no intercessor like Samuel to seek mercy from before the Omnipresent for the Messiah and for the Redemption and for His Kingdom, that it may be revealed in the whole world, and for His great Right Hand, that He might return it before Him to perform a great salvation for Israel.
48.3: Immediately, the Holy One, Blessed be He, remembers His own righteousness, His merit, His mercy, and His kindness, and He saves His great arm for Himself, and His righteousness sustained Him, even as it is said: “And He saw that there was no man”—like Moses, who used to seek mercy many times in the wilderness for Israel and annulled the decree from upon Israel. “And He wondered that there was no intercessor”—like Samuel, who entreated the Holy One, Blessed be He, and called to Him, and He answered him. And he [Samuel] adjured the Holy One, Blessed be He, [to do] His will, even if they were not worthy, even as it is said: “Is it not wheat harvest today? I will call unto the LORD.” And not only that, but “I answered Moses in every place,” as it is said: “Moses and Aaron among His priests.” And further: “Though Moses and Samuel stood before Me,” and “My own arm brought salvation unto Me.”
48.4: The Holy One, Blessed be He, said at that hour: “Even though, until when shall I wait for human beings to work salvation for My arm through their righteousness? Even so, for My own sake and by way of My merit and My righteousness, I will save My arm and I will bring up My children from among the nations of the world,” as it is said: “For My own sake, even for My own sake, will I do it; for how should My name be profaned?” At that hour, the Holy One, Blessed be He, reveals His great arm to the world and shows it to the nations of the world; its length is like the length of the world, from one end of the world to the other, and its width is like the width of the world, and the light of its appearance is like the brilliance of the sun.
48.5: His burial in the season of Tammuz [is rescued] from the hand of the nations of the world, and Israel rejoices in it because of their arrival. And the Messiah appears to them, who shall bring them up to Jerusalem in great joy. Not only that, but they shall enjoy the kingdom of the Messiah in the four quarters of the world, and the nations of the world shall not enjoy it with them, as it is said: “The LORD has bared His holy arm in the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God” (Isa. 52:10). And it says: “The LORD alone shall lead him, and there is no strange god with him” (Deut. 32:12), and “The LORD shall be King over all the earth” (Zech. 14:9).
48.6: These are the names of the [attributes of the] Holy One, Blessed be He, who go forth with many crowns of fire, with many crowns of flame, with many crowns of hashmal, with many crowns of blazing, with many crowns of lightning from before the Throne of Glory. And with them are seventy camps of the Shekhinah and a multitude of the hosts of Might, who uphold the King in glory, in preciousness, in strength, and with much singing and rejoicing, and with pillars of fire and pillars of flame, with lightnings of light and with the appearance of hashmal. They gave them honor and delight, and they cry out before Him: “Holy, Holy, Holy,” as it is said: “And one cried to another and said: Holy, Holy, Holy” (Isa. 6:3). And they are praised in every firmament of the heights. Seven mighty and honored kings, and with joy they run to the place of the Throne of Glory of the Hayyot that are in the Merkavah.
48.7: They open their mouths in praise of the glory of the name of the Holy One, Blessed be He. Blessed be He who has granted a portion of the life of the Holy One, Blessed be He. I created him to take him; I appointed Metatron, My servant, who is unique among all the celestial beings. I created him in the generation of the first Adam. But when I looked upon the generation of the Flood, that they were corrupted and coming [to ruin], I withdrew My Shekhinah from among them and I brought him up with the sound of the shofar and a shout to the heights, as it is said: “God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a shofar” (Ps. 47:6). And I took Enoch, son of Jared, from among them, and I brought him up with the sound of the shofar and a shout to the heavens of the heights to be for Me a witness with the Hayyot of the Merkavah forever.
48.8: I appointed him over all the treasuries and storehouses that I have in every firmament, and the key of each and every one I delivered into his hand. And I made him Prince over all the princes, a minister of My Throne of Glory in the Palace of Arabot, to open their doors for Me, and to exalt and arrange the Throne of Glory and the Holy Hayyot, to bind crowns upon their heads.
48.9: And the Ophannim of splendor crown them with strength and glory; the Cherubim of majesty clothe them with splendor, and lightnings of radiance make them shine with brightness and luster. Seraphim of flame wrap them in grandeur, and Hashmallim of light illuminate them. And He, at every dawn, prepares for Himself a seat, as He sits upon His throne in glory and preciousness, to see His glory in the height of His strength—the lightnings of the upper realms and the lightnings of the lower realms are His exaltation. Therefore his stature is raised above all the heights of statures; seventy thousand parasangs is the greatness of his stature from the majesty of His throne.
48.10: And I increased his glory from the majesty of My glory; I turned his flesh into torches of fire and all the bones of his body into coals of fire. The luster of the sight of his eyes is like the appearance of lightning, and the light of his eyelids is as a light that is never absent. The brilliance of his face is like the light of the sun’s luster, and the radiance of his teeth is like the luster of the Throne of Glory. I made his garment majesty and splendor, and his covering is of the beauty of grandeur. I fashioned his royal crown five hundred by five hundred parasangs, and I placed upon him of My majesty, of My glory, and of the luster of My glory which is upon the Throne of Glory.
48.11: I called him by My name, “The Lesser YHWH,” Prince of the Presence, and Counselor of Mysteries; and every single mystery I revealed to him in love, and every single secret I made known to him in uprightness. I established his throne at the entrance of My palace on the outside, to sit and execute judgment over all My heavenly host [familia] in the height. And every prince I made subservient to him, to [submit to him and] perform My will through him. Seventy names I bestowed upon him from My names, and I called him [thus] here to increase his glory.
48.12: Seventy princes I gave into his hand, to appoint from among them over every language the charges of his words: to humble the proud by his word unto the earth, and to exalt [the lowly] by the utterance of his lips unto the height; to strike kings with his command, to subdue the proud with his speech, to remove kings from their domains, and to establish rulers over their domains. As it is said: “And He changes the times and the seasons,” etc. (Dan. 2:21), to give wisdom to all the wise of the world, and understanding and knowledge to those who know science. As it is said: “And knowledge to those who know understanding,” to reveal to them the mysteries of My words, and to teach them the decree of the judgment of My laws. As it is said: “For so shall My word be that goes out of My mouth; it shall not return to Me void, but [it shall accomplish] that which I please” (Isa. 55:11). It is not said here “I will do,” but rather “that which he repeated,” teaching that every word and every utterance And it is recounted that there went forth from before the Holy One, blessed be He, the name of Metatron; and He established him from His own essence and he fulfills the decree of the Holy One, blessed be He, and he prospered that for which He sent him. It was not said "and it prospered," but rather "and he prospered," which teaches that regarding every single decree that goes forth from before the Holy One, blessed be He, against a man—once that man performs repentance, they do not send it upon him for punishment, but rather they send it upon another man, a wicked one, for punishment, as it is said: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes in his stead (Proverbs 11:8).
48.13: Furthermore, every day Metatron sits for three hours in the heights of heaven and gathers all those embryos who died in their mothers' wombs, and the sucklings who died at their mothers' breasts, and the schoolchildren who died over the Five Books of the Torah, and he brings them beneath the Throne of Glory. He seats them in groups and companies and bands before him, and he teaches them Torah, wisdom, lore, and traditions, and he completes the Torah for them, as it is said: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand tradition? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts (Isaiah 28:9).
48.14: Metatron has seventy names, which the Holy One, blessed be He, took from His own name and gave to Metatron, who is Enoch son of Jared. And these are they: Yahoel, Yah, Yahoel, Jophiel and Jophphiel, and Aphaphiel, and Marganiel, Gital, Petiel, Shehaphadiel, Tatriel, Akhtriel, On, YHWH—this was the servant—Zevuriel, Aphaphiel, Saphaphiel, Patspatsiel, Sanron, Metatron, Suniron, Adrigon, Estas, Skaps, Skatas, Migon, Miton, Mituron, Rukhphis, Kitot, Atatya, Asasya, and Gazatsya, Patspatsya, Abatshasya, Makharnash, Bardash, Makharkakh, Ma'atad, Chashtash, Chashbash, Matartatat, Batsya, Itmon, Titmon, Paskon, Tsaptsaphya, Zerach, Zerachya, Chava, Biya, Havhavya, Pelet, Palatya, and Berakhya, Chas, Chasya, Taptaphya, Tamgamgya, Tse-Tsehya, Ar'arya, Al'alya, and Zerizya, and Zerizya, Sakhsa'ya, Saslasya, Lazrya, Kuzazya, Arimya, Savahya, Samarskakhya, Samakhas Yahsya, Abtsabihya, Tsabtsabanya, Qali La-qali Bih-h-h Ha-yah Ve-h Ha-yah, Zakzakhya, Totrisya, Kuzarya, and Haphanirya, and Ashya Ruach Malmallekha, Otiah, Emek Qameia, Tseltselia, Tsabtsabia, Nanunasho, Nashtia, Midparish Parishia, Shafat Shafatia, Hasamia, Sharshia. And by the hand of His might, upon the highest, and He said to him: "Faithful gate," the hand of the lesser upon the name of the greater, as it is said: For My name is in him (Exodus 23:21). And Seraphiel, Shemiel, Sagnasagael, Prince of Wisdom. And why is his name called Sagnasagael?
48.15: Because all the treasuries of wisdom are handed over into his hand; and they were all opened to Moses at Sinai until he taught them to him in forty days while he was standing in the Torah—in seventy facets of seventy languages; Laws, in seventy facets of seventy languages; Traditions, in seventy facets of seventy languages; Lore, in seventy facets of seventy languages; Supplements, in seventy facets of seventy languages.
48.16: And once they were concluded for him at the end of forty days, he forgot them all in a single hour, until he called: "Give unto me, Paniah!"—the Prince of Torah—and he gave them to Moses as a gift, as it is said: And the Lord gave them to me (Deuteronomy 9:10). And afterward, it was established for him. And from where do we know that it was established for him? As it is said: Remember the Torah of Moses My servant (Malachi 3:22). "The Torah of Moses"—these are the Torah, the Prophets, and the Writings; "Statutes"—these are the Laws and Mishnayot; "Judgments"—these are the Lore and the Supplements; all of them were given to Moses at Sinai.
48.17: These are the sixty-seven names, of the likeness of the Explicit Name in the Chariot, which are engraved upon the Throne of Glory, which He took from His Explicit Name and bestowed upon the name of Metatron. Seventy names he has, by which they call Him, and the ministering angels [call him] in the heights of heaven. And [there are] twenty-six seals—Shevava’a Eve’u—by which all the orders of the Arabot firmament were sealed; by it were sealed the gates of the Princes of Kingdoms in the heights, in kingdoms, in dominions, in greatness, and in majesty; by it were sealed the gates of the Angel of Death and the gates of every nation and language. I, Metatron, the Angel, Prince of the Face; and the Angel, Prince of the Torah; and the Angel, Prince of Wisdom; and the Angel, Prince of Understanding; and the Angel, Prince of Kings; and the Angel, Prince of Nobles; and the Angel, Prince of Glory; and the Angel, Prince of Kings; and the Angel, Prince of Princes.
48.18: The exalted and high princes, many and honored in heaven and on earth: The Lord God of Israel is my witness in this matter that when I ascended to the heights to Moses, all the hosts of the heights in every firmament trembled against me and said to me: "Small one! Why do you bring up this secret to a son of man, born of woman—those of discharges, those of impurity, those of blood, and those of the fetid drop? A secret through which were created heaven and earth, sea and dry land, mountains and hills, depths and springs, Gehenna, fire, and hail, the Garden of Eden and the Tree of Life; and through it were formed Adam and Eve, cattle and the beasts of the field, the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, the behemoths of Leviathan, and creeping things and detestable creatures, the swarming things of the sea and the creeping things of the desert; [matters] conducted with wisdom, knowledge, thought, and the understanding of the supernal beings, and fear of heaven. Small one! Why do you bring [this] up to flesh and blood?"
48.19: And I said to them: "Small ones! The Omnipresent has given me permission, and they have sent permission from the high and lofty Throne; for all the Explicit Names go forth from before Him like sparks of fire, and flashes of radiance, and chashmal of flame." And their minds were not set at ease until He rebuked them and removed them from before Him with a reprimand. And He said to them: "I have willed, and I have desired, and I have commanded, and I have handed [them] over to Metatron My servant—insofar as he is one of all the denizens of the heights."
48.20: And Metatron brought them out from My house of treasures and handed them over to Moses; and Moses to Joshua; and Joshua to the Elders; and the Elders to the Prophets; and the Prophets to the Men of the Great Assembly; and the Men of the Great Assembly to Ezra the Scribe; and Ezra the Scribe to Hillel the Elder; and Hillel the Elder to Rabbi Abbahu; and [Rabbi] Abbahu to [Rabbi] Gila; and [Rabbi] Gila to the Men of Faith; and the Men of Faith to the Masters of Beliefs—to be heedful of it and to be healed by it from the sicknesses that break out in the world. As it is said: If you will diligently listen to the voice of the Lord your God, and do what is right in His eyes, and give ear to His commandments, and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I put on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord your healer. (Exodus 15:26).
